description: Generate a new AI presentation deck from a prompt, notes, or URLs. GenPPT researches and writes the outline. Returns at once; the concept is ready in about a minute. Uses one deck from the plan allowance.

aspectRatio.description: Slide shape. Default '16:9'. '4:5' or '3:4' = X 20-image portrait posts, LinkedIn PDF carousels, Instagram feed carousels. '9:16' = TikTok Photo Mode, Instagram Reels and Stories. '2:3' = Pinterest. '1:1' = square threads and posts. '16:9' = widescreen decks. '4:3' and '3:2' = classic screens and photo prints.

attachmentUrls.description: Public URLs (up to 20) of files, images, or YouTube videos to use as sources.

prompt.description: What the deck is about: topic, audience, notes, outline, or pasted text.

referenceImageUrls.description: Public image URLs (up to 20): logos, products, screenshots, or style references to show or match.

webSearchEnabled.description: Let the agent research the web. Default true.

websiteUrl.description: Company or product website to ground the deck in.

name: genppt_create_deck
title: Create deck
